heading: Printable directories
wizard_step2_description: Search for what the first section should list, and pick the location the directory covers. You can add more sections and change the location later.
wizard_query_help: Optional — you can also add this later from the directory page.
try_different_search_or_create: Try a different search term or create a new printable directory.
slug_taken_error: This slug is already in use. Please choose a different one.
share_url_help: Anyone with this link can download the PDF. Changing it breaks links you have already shared.
share_slug_missing_tooltip: Set a share slug in General info before sharing
share_dialog_description: Choose the format recipients will see, then copy the link.

access_policy_description.private: Only you can open and edit it here.
access_policy_description.shared_read: Other users with access to printable directories can open it; only you can edit it.
access_policy_description.shared_edit: Other users with access to printable directories can open and edit it.

delete_directory_description: Are you sure you want to delete this printable directory? This action cannot be undone.
load_error: Unable to load directories. Please refresh and try again.
cover_image_description: Upload a front cover image to replace the title/description cover page, and a back cover image to add a closing page. If no images are set, the directory uses the default text cover.
layout_reorder_hint: Click + to add item to layout. Use arrows to re-order selected items.
query_param_overrides_default_location: This query parameter overrides the default location configuration
no_sources: This section has no sources yet. Go to search results or a favorites list and save it here.
public_preview_meta_description: A printable directory shared with you.
public_preview_not_found: This shared directory could not be found.
public_preview_error: Something went wrong generating this PDF.
capability_required: Your account does not include this feature.

localized_field.auto_translate_hint: Empty languages are translated automatically when you save. Edited translations are kept.
localized_field.auto_translate_paused_user_quota: Automatic translation is paused until next month because you reached your monthly translation limit. Saving still works, and you can type translations yourself.
localized_field.auto_translate_paused_tenant_cap: Automatic translation is paused until next month because this site reached its monthly translation limit. Saving still works, and you can type translations yourself.

languages_help: The languages this directory is translated into and can be printed or shared in.
wizard_location_help: Used by every section that doesn’t set its own location.
unable_to_add_source: The directory was created, but its query could not be added. You can add it from the directory page.
logo_help: Printed wherever the header or footer layout includes Logo. Without one, the site logo is used.
scheduled_delivery_description: Email this directory's PDF automatically on the days you choose. Deliveries go out around 3:00 AM Eastern Time.
scheduled_delivery_empty: No scheduled deliveries yet. Add a schedule to email the PDF on chosen days of the week or month.
scheduled_delivery_last_run_sent_as_link: Last sent {{date}} as a link (PDF too large to attach)
scheduled_delivery_last_run_skipped: Skipped on {{date}}: its creator can no longer schedule deliveries
scheduled_delivery_locale_removed: This language was removed from the directory, so it will be sent in {{language}}.
scheduled_delivery_send_test: Send a test to me now
scheduled_delivery_test_failed: Couldn't send the test email. Please try again.
scheduled_delivery_delete_description: Its recipients will stop receiving this PDF.
scheduled_delivery_save_failed: Couldn't save the schedule. Please try again.
scheduled_delivery_limit_reached: This directory already has {{max}} schedules, the maximum.
scheduled_delivery_month_days_help: Days 29–31 aren't available, so every month gets every delivery.
scheduled_delivery_recipients_help: Separate addresses with commas or new lines. Recipients can't see each other's addresses.
scheduled_delivery_recipients_required: Add at least one email address.
scheduled_delivery_recipients_too_many: Remove some addresses. The limit is {{max}}.
scheduled_delivery_email_attached: The PDF is attached to this email.
scheduled_delivery_email_too_large: The PDF is too large to attach.

scheduled_delivery_email_footer: You're receiving this because {{email}} scheduled this delivery. Reply to this email to contact them.
scheduled_delivery_failure_intro: The scheduled delivery of {{title}} for {{date}} couldn't be sent.
scheduled_delivery_reason_preview_failed: The directory's resources couldn't be loaded.
scheduled_delivery_reason_too_large_with: The PDF is too large to attach, and the directory has no share URL to link to instead. Give the directory a share URL to fix this.
scheduled_delivery_dialog_description: Choose when the PDF is sent, which version, and who receives it.

scheduled_delivery_skipped_intro: The scheduled delivery of {{title}} for {{date}} wasn't sent.
